method: Primary-agent comparison of preserved v21 cases under evidence-context isolation. This is a known-case regression rerun, not a fresh holdout. No case/label/prompt changed after either run. Different original sets receive separate support calls; same sets can still share one.
fixed_false_approval: Skua independent encrypted-storage/map facts are now correctly rejected as an instrumental relationship; Siskin explicit relationship remains accepted. This observes the isolated invocation result, without proving the cause of the v21 false approval.
remaining_false_rejection: Gannet runs backups daily is still falsely rejected despite its adjoining original sentence.
latency_note: The rerun took 648.838 s versus 242.503 s previously. Inference-call count increased 6 to 11; wall-time comparison was not a controlled benchmark, so its full change cannot be attributed to call isolation.
